arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK033. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. Extreme upward-looking head/upper body, snout tilted UP-LEFT and PALE UNDERSIDE of the jaw/chin facing viewer. Mouth open at top-left with pink tongue inside, small visible eye high at upper-right edge peering over the raised snout. Preserve original body roll and upward camera angle; do not substitute the shared left profile or normal right-facing head. White/pale-blue waterline at base; no tail. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
